the next tracker is not the thing that's missing

slides.text:
The ring measured well

The watch measured well

The band would also
measure well

Measuring was never the gap

Nothing new to buy

It reads what's
already on your wrist

The gap was always
the sentence after the number

slides.heading: No new hardware
slides.body: SOMA works with the sensors you already own — Apple Health, Apple Watch, Oura, Whoop
